messages:
Nadia: Postmortem posted. Need owners for customer comms: status page blurb, 72h customer summary, and an RCA-sharing playbook (redaction + NDA flow). Can we assign owners by EOD?
Cal: I can take status page blurb. Short, factual, include region impact and "no evidence of data loss". ETA 3h.
Renee: I will do the 72h summary. Plan: tl;dr, timeline, who affected, mitigation, next steps, how to request more info. ETA 24h.
Nadia: Legal/controls: RCA-sharing playbook should define three tiers: public summary, sanitized RCA, full RCA on request (NDA + redaction review). We need a redaction checklist and an approval flow. Who owns?
Renee: I'd prefer Legal to own the playbook but can help with customer wording.
Nadia: Ok assigning playbook to Legal (TBD). Also infra noted repeated cache-eviction events -> tag as "eviction-series" and open infra follow-up for detection thresholds.
ops-bot: Created ACTION-4999 (comms) and ACTION-5000 (infra pattern review).
Cal: Draft statuspage v0:
"Partial service degradation for a subset of customers in APAC between 02:10-02:42 UTC. Service restored after failover at 02:42 UTC. No evidence of data exposure. We are implementing safeguards to reduce similar events."
Cal: Adding contact: support@redwood.ai and note that affected customers will receive a direct summary.
Renee: 72h summary ETA confirmed. I will include contact & request flow (support@redwood.ai, review SLA 7 business days).
Nadia: Please upload drafts to ACTION-4999 before EOD. I'll schedule a 20-minute sync tomorrow 09:45 UTC to review.
Cal: Posting statuspage draft to ACTION-4999 now.
Renee: Uploading 72h draft by 09:00 UTC tomorrow.
Nadia: Legal will post playbook draft within 72h. If infra wants early input on exportable artifacts, ping legal.
ops-bot: ACTION-4999 updated -> owners: Cal, Renee, Legal. Due dates recorded.
Nadia: Thanks all. Final checklist: statuspage live (Cal), 72h summary in tracker (Renee), RCA playbook draft (Legal). Infra follow-up ACTION-5000 for repeated evictions. If blocked DM me.
Cal: ack.
Renee: ack.
